listenings.text: Hi, sorry, I am recording this on the bus because I am going to an interview and I am already nervous. Anyway. I am doing something different this month. I am not applying to the big names anymore, because everybody applies there and nobody answers. I am searching for smaller companies instead, and guess what, two of them replied in three days. Three days. I am updating my CV for each one now, which takes forever, but it is working. What are you doing about yours right now? Tell me, because I need ideas.

Good afternoon and welcome back to the careers fair. I am standing in front of the biggest stand and the queue is getting longer every minute. They are not really talking to anybody, to be honest. They are just collecting CVs and saying thank you. Now, over on the left, something different is happening. The small companies are talking to every single student, and two of them are interviewing people on the spot, right here. So here is my advice: go to the small stands first. Nobody is waiting there. Back to you.

items.situation: Someone messages: "What are you doing?" Answer with two sentences, not one.
Ask me two questions about what I am doing this month.
Say one thing you are doing this month that is not normal for you.
A recruiter asks what you are doing at the moment. Answer in two sentences.
Describe what three people around you are doing right now.
